channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Couple Charged After Infant Found Deceased in Adelaide Motel
item.description: South Australian police have charged a man and a woman after a baby boy, aged between six and seven months, was found deceased in an Adelaide motel. The infant had reportedly been deceased for a period of time. Benjamin Nicholas Houghton… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Ilhan Omar's Home Raided Amid Immigration Fraud Investigation
item.description: Federal agents raided the Washington D.C. home of Congresswoman Ilhan Omar as part of an immigration fraud investigation. Omar stated she would "not be silenced" and called the raid the "latest escalation" in President Donald Trump's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Businessman David Stewart's $42m spray paint business linked to alleged crimes
item.description: Businessman David Stewart's $42 million spray paint business has been linked to allegations of dodgy books, arson attacks, and a murder plot. The Sydney Morning Herald reported on these alleged criminal activities connected to Stewart's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Philippine VP Sara Duterte Faces Dropped Impeachment Charges
item.description: Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte had most impeachment charges against her dropped by the Philippine Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, on Tuesday. Prosecutors had presented evidence for weeks supporting the charges, which could… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delta flight from New York to Tel Aviv isolated after bomb threat
item.description: A Delta flight traveling from New York to Tel Aviv was isolated at Ben-Gurion Airport following an anonymous bomb threat. Emergency services responded to the incident, which prompted a significant security response. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Drones Strike Ships Off Bulgaria, One Sinks; NATO Aid Sought
item.description: Two ships off the coast of Bulgaria in the Black Sea were struck by drones of unknown origin. One vessel sank, while the other sustained damage. Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev stated that one person was rescued and that he is seeking… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Stabbing in South Korea Injures Multiple People
item.description: A stabbing incident occurred in Incheon, South Korea, resulting in multiple injuries. At least six people were hurt, with one reportedly in cardiac arrest. Police have arrested one man and are investigating his motive. South Korean media… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Maharashtra Forms Panel to Probe MPSC Irregularities, Chiefs Under Scrutiny
item.description: The Maharashtra government has established a committee to investigate irregularities within the Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC). The probe will scrutinize both current and former chiefs of the MPSC. This action follows a row… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Two Workers Die During Chennai Corporation Motor Repair
item.description: Two workers died of suffocation while repairing a motor at a stormwater drainage sump in Kodungaiyur, Chennai. The incident involved the Chennai Corporation. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Kills Wife in Hyderabad; Police Register Case
item.description: A 30-year-old woman was allegedly stabbed to death by her husband in Hyderabad. The incident occurred after the husband reportedly suspected his wife of infidelity. The accused fled the scene, and the police have registered a case in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi High Court orders removal of AI deepfakes of Kangana Ranaut
item.description: The Delhi High Court has ordered Meta to remove artificial intelligence-generated deepfakes and other fake content impersonating actress Kangana Ranaut. The court granted Ranaut personality rights protection, directing the social media… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: BMC Notices Contractor Over Soil Use on Mumbai Coastal Road
item.description: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has issued a show-cause notice to a contractor regarding the alleged unauthorized use of soil on the Mumbai Coastal Road project. The notice was served to L&T-HCC, a joint venture involved in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Family Members Murdered Over Superstition in Chhattisgarh
item.description: Three family members were arrested in connection with a double murder in Chhattisgarh, allegedly carried out due to suspicion of witchcraft. The accused reportedly used a 'tangia' (axe) to kill their aunt and brother, and also attacked… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Court Halts Unauthorized Screenings of Rajinikanth Film 'Jailer 2'
item.description: The Madras High Court has issued an interim injunction preventing the unauthorized exhibition of the Rajinikanth-starrer 'Jailer 2'. Justice P.B. Balaji passed the orders in response to copyright infringement suits filed by Sun TV Network… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Congress MP Faces Sexual Harassment Allegations at JNU
item.description: Congress MP Angomcha Bimol Akoijam is facing sexual harassment allegations at Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU). The university had previously sacked him, and an FIR has been filed. Akoijam has described the allegations as "harassment" and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Bombay HC: Insisting on religious conversion not an insult
item.description: The Bombay High Court ruled that insisting on religious conversion does not amount to insulting religious beliefs. The court made this observation while hearing a case. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Examines Prosecuting Election Commissioners
item.description: The Supreme Court is examining whether the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) and other Election Commissioners can be prosecuted. The court has sought responses from the Centre and the Election Commission of India (ECI) on this matter. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: CJP activists detained near Jantar Mantar; founder criticizes action
item.description: Delhi Police detained Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das, and Ajinkya Shinde, associated with the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), near Jantar Mantar. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke criticized the detentions, questioning if hoisting the national flag at… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Drug activist shot dead in Punjab, colleague injured
item.description: Drug activist Parminder Singh Zotta was shot dead and his colleague critically injured in Mansa, Punjab. The incident reportedly stemmed from a dispute over drug sales at a medical store. Zotta was known for his activism against drug abuse… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Drone Attack Sinks Ship Off Bulgaria's Black Sea Coast
item.description: A Ukrainian-owned ship, the "Chelsea 3," sank off the coast of Bulgaria after being hit by three drones, according to Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev. The incident occurred in the Black Sea, and all crew members were rescued. This is… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Karnataka Minister Orders Review of Bengaluru Police Action on Protesters
item.description: Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge has ordered a review of the Bengaluru police's handling of anti-SIR (Strategic Interventions and Reforms) protesters who were detained on Monday. The review follows allegations that police forcibly… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: IAS Officer and Friends Booked for Allegedly Assaulting Bengaluru Police
item.description: An FIR has been registered against an IAS officer from Andhra Pradesh cadre and three of his friends for allegedly assaulting and abusing police personnel at a pub in Bengaluru. The incident occurred when a police team was inspecting bars… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Anti-drug activist shot dead by medical store owner in Punjab
item.description: Anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh alias Jhota was shot dead by a medical store owner in Mansa, Punjab. The incident occurred when Jhota was questioning the owner about the sale of certain drugs and recording the argument on his mobile… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: Judge Halts Trump Golf Course Tree Removal After Hundreds Cut
item.description: A judge has halted further tree removal at the East Potomac golf course in Washington D.C. after 430 to 500 trees were cut down over a weekend. The judge expressed outrage and fury over the demolition of the trees, which were part of a… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Alleged Crime Boss Daniel Kinahan to Defend Himself in Court
item.description: Alleged Irish crime boss Daniel Kinahan intends to "vehemently defend" himself in court and will apply for bail in the coming weeks. The specific charges or court proceedings were not detailed in the provided coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sean 'Diddy' Combs Hospitalized with Head Injury from Prison
item.description: Sean 'Diddy' Combs was taken to the hospital from prison after sustaining a head injury. The incident occurred while he was in custody, and he received medical treatment. Details regarding the specific circumstances of the injury and his… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Clarifies Stance on New Form 6 in Bihar SIR Case
item.description: The Supreme Court has clarified its position on the new Form 6, stating that it has neither approved nor disapproved of the changes. These alterations, introduced in July, require applicants to provide ancestry details or linkage to… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 12 · Right 2.

item.title: BJP alleges Rahul Gandhi pushed pregnant journalist
item.description: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has accused Congress leader Rahul Gandhi of pushing a pregnant woman journalist and causing her injury. The party also alleged that Gandhi elbowed one of his own party workers. According to the BJP, the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Police Detain Activists at Jantar Mantar
item.description: Delhi Police detained activists Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, associated with the CJP (Citizens for Justice and Peace), at Jantar Mantar. The activists were reportedly holding a Tiranga (national flag) and chanting slogans. Police stated… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 12 · Right 3.

item.title: Two Pakistan Army pilots killed in training aircraft crash
item.description: A Pakistan Army training aircraft crashed near Quetta, resulting in the deaths of two pilots. The crash was reportedly due to a technical fault. Following the incident, Pakistan's President and Prime Minister expressed their condolences. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 2.

item.title: Tata Trusts Granted Extension to Respond to Trustee Complaints
item.description: The Charity Commissioner of Maharashtra has granted the Sir Dorabji Tata Trust, which holds 27.98% of Tata Sons, an additional week to respond to complaints filed by two trustees, Venu Srinivasan and Vijay Singh. The deadline for the Trust… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Four killed in Poonch LoC blast, identities disputed
item.description: Four people were killed in an IED or landmine blast on the Line of Control in Poonch district of Jammu & Kashmir; the explosion killed four individuals from the Pakistan‑occupied side and security was heightened afterwards, while reports… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: Five deaths on Michigan trail raise serial killer fears
item.description: Authorities are investigating whether a serial killer is responsible for five deaths discovered along a trail in Michigan. Fears of a serial killer have grown following the discovery of the bodies. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Stolen Renoir Paintings Recovered Using DNA and Vehicle Tracking
item.description: French investigators recovered two stolen Renoir paintings using DNA evidence found on a protective cover and vehicle-tracking technology. The recovery also led to the uncovering of suspected preparations for another art heist, according… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Killer of Molly Ticehurst Plans Appeal Against 28-Year Sentence
item.description: The killer of Molly Ticehurst is planning to appeal his 28-year sentence. Ticehurst's father has expressed dismay at the prospect of an appeal, stating "He's got a hide." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UK PM Blames Iran Guards for Airbase Incident
item.description: British Prime Minister Rishi Sunak stated that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) was "almost certainly" behind an incident at the RAF Fairford airbase. The nature of the threat and the specific actions taken remain unclear… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 8 · Right 0.

item.title: Over 20 journalists allege police force; three detained, moved 12 km, then released
item.description: More than 20 journalists have alleged that Delhi Police used brute force against them, and police reportedly detained three Indian Express reporters, moved them about 12 km away from the city, and later released them. Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Qantas Plane Grounded in Rome Due to Bedbug Infestation
item.description: A Qantas aircraft was grounded in Rome after a bedbug infestation was discovered on board. The plane had arrived from Perth, and passengers on its previous journey had complained of bug bites. The discovery led to the cancellation of the… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Pakistan detains PTI members amid protests and emergency rule
item.description: Hundreds of individuals associated with former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan's Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) party have been detained following the imposition of emergency rule on October 11 in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, the party's… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Christa Pike returns to prison after botched execution and hospital stay
item.description: Christa Pike, who survived a botched execution attempt, has been discharged from the hospital and returned to a Tennessee prison. She was reportedly "angry" over the execution not being completed and had been "ready to die." Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 8 · Right 0.
